main_body: T-shaped timber support prop consisting of a wide horizontal top crossbeam over a vertical support post
top_band: Light ochre-tan horizontal top face of the crossbeam at rows 10-12 with a bright cream front-edge highlight at row 13 (below the dark brown back edge at row 9)
evidence: Reading down column 7: row 9 is the dark brown back edge; rows 10-12 are a 3-row light tan horizontal top surface with wood grain; row 13 is a distinct 1-row cream front-edge highlight line (total 4 top rows); rows 14-17 form the darker brown vertical south face of the crossbeam; rows 18-47 form the vertical timber post set back underneath with an eave shadow at rows 18-19.

style.evidence: The wood ramp uses 6 distinct value steps from the cream edge highlight through light ochre, mid-tan, medium brown, dark brown knots/shading, and deep warm brown outlines. Side edges of the crossbeam terminate by value alone without black outlines, and both the beam and post carry varied wood grain, pegs, and banding matching the Beodeul reference props.
